changes.title: Magic dodge
items: Your dodge leaves a moonlit afterimage where you stood and a smear along the way, instead of a white flash
Your broom drops a few amber sparks as you fly, and the speed spell's trail is warm amber and rose

changes.title: Magic sigils
items: Putting a sigil down writes it in with a warm amber ring and motes of its creature's colour rising; picking it up draws the motes back to you
Cycling your sigils in the treetops makes the new bottom one flare
Quick moments (a sigil put down, a creature joining) no longer go missing when the game runs at a lower frame rate

changes.title: Magic letters
items: Your 💌s leave a faint warm trail as they fly, land on the ground with a soft rose puff, and a hit lands with a rose ring and amber sparks instead of a white flash
